text: {"lessons":["My account rose substantially before giving back some gains, reminding me that short-term losses are part of investing and do not by themselves justify a trade.","Because losses hurt me more than equal gains please me, I should guard against panic-selling and review each holding against my long-term plan instead.","Selling Stock A at a large gain felt satisfying, but neither that satisfaction nor reluctance to admit a mistake should drive future decisions; I should base trades on risk, diversification, and current information."]}
